development_requirements: BFE must be established by applicant via hydraulic study (HEC-RAS modeling)
Floodplain Development Permit required from City of Palm Bay (Code Chapter 174)
All structures elevated above BFE + 1 ft minimum freeboard (Florida Building Code 8th Ed.)
Elevation Certificate (FEMA Form FF-206-FY-22-152) required at 3 construction stages
Flood insurance mandatory for federally-backed mortgages
LOMA/LOMR-F option available if fill raises lot above BFE (no FEMA fee, ~60 day processing)
Residential floodproofing NOT permitted under NFIP — must elevate

palm_bay_hcp.nesting_season_restriction: March 1 - June 30 — land clearing PROHIBITED in occupied polygons
palm_bay_hcp.gopher_tortoise_note: Separate FWC permit required — NOT covered by City HCP ITP

potentially_relevant_species.relevance: Uses freshwater emergent wetlands for foraging. USFWS consultation may be required within 18.6-mile Core Foraging Area of active colonies.
Uses freshwater marshes/emergent wetlands — PEM1Cd habitat type
Upland portions only. 100% survey required before land clearing. FWC relocation permit if burrows found.
Scrub habitat — unlikely in PEM wetland but check adjacent uplands and Palm Bay scrub-jay lot database
Nest buffers apply if nests within 660 ft. Check FWC eagle nest locator.

environmental_resource_permit.trigger: Any activity affecting surface water, wetlands, or stormwater
environmental_resource_permit.fee: $9,000 (standard general ERP, <640 acres, <50 ac wetland impact)

section_404_permit.agency: FDEP (state assumed from USACE since Dec 22, 2020)
section_404_permit.note: Florida assumed CWA Section 404 permitting for most freshwater palustrine wetlands. Joint ERP/404 application processed through SJRWMD/FDEP. Verify if retained waters (within 300 ft of navigable waterway) require federal USACE jurisdiction.
section_404_permit.standard: Applicant must demonstrate avoidance, minimization, and mitigation

floodplain_development_permit.requirement: Required before any construction in Zone A SFHA

listed_species_surveys.gopher_tortoise: 100% survey + FWC relocation permit if burrows found
listed_species_surveys.scrub_jay: Check Palm Bay scrub-jay lots database
listed_species_surveys.wood_stork: USFWS consultation if within Core Foraging Area
listed_species_surveys.general_listed_species_survey: Recommended pre-development survey for all state/federal listed species

wetland_mitigation_credits.note: ~0.3-0.5 UMAM credits at $125K-$200K/credit in south Brevard. Farmton Mitigation Bank is primary bank.

estimated_environmental_costs.note: Mitigation credits ($40K-$100K) are the largest single cost component. Partially drained wetland status may reduce but not eliminate mitigation requirements.

constraint_severity_assessment.rationale: Triple constraint stacking (wetland + flood + wellhead) with estimated $77K-$203K in environmental compliance costs BEFORE any design or construction. Wetland mitigation alone could exceed the $55K land value.
blocking_items: BFE must be established before any building design can proceed
Formal wetland delineation required to determine actual jurisdictional boundary
PUD ordinance must be obtained to confirm what development is permitted
Listed species surveys must be completed before land clearing
